title: Phrase-aware caption chunker
summary: Splits narration into single-line caption chunks of at most 7 words using dynamic programming that prefers punctuation and pauses, avoids function-word endings and keeps numbers with units.
examples: Chunk a narration script into <=7-word caption lines
Group Whisper word timestamps into captions

review.notes: Unit tests pass with pytest on Python 3.13 (numpy, Pillow); ffmpeg integration tests ran with ffmpeg present.
